PROP-01b-partial2-inv-024.text: Market validation must check both MarketType registration and object ID to prevent spoofing.

PROP-01b-partial2-asm-001.text: Oracle price feeds must be fresh and within acceptable confidence interval.
PROP-01b-partial2-asm-001.assertion: forall price_query(oracle, clock): price.timestamp >= clock.now - max_staleness

PROP-01b-partial2-asm-002.text: Pyth oracle confidence interval must be checked to reject unreliable price data.

PROP-01b-partial2-asm-003.text: Obligation owner capability must be required for deposit, borrow, withdraw, and claim operations.
PROP-01b-partial2-asm-003.assertion: forall op in {deposit, borrow, withdraw, claim}: caller owns ObligationOwnerCap matching obligation

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-025.text: Flash loan within same PTB must not manipulate exchange rate to profit from deposit/withdraw.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-025.assertion: flash_loan borrow/repay must not affect exchange_rate used in concurrent mint/burn in same tx

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-026.text: Flash loan must not be usable to bypass obligation safety check via temporary liquidity injection.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-026.assertion: flash_loan lock prevents borrow/withdraw during active flash loan in same market

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-027.text: Self-liquidation must not be profitable: liquidator cannot liquidate own obligation for net gain.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-027.assertion: forall self_liq(user): value(seized_collateral) - value(repaid_debt) <= 0 for self-liquidation

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-028.text: Deposit amount must not breach per-asset max_deposit_amount limit.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-028.assertion: forall deposit(amt, asset): total_deposits(asset) + amt <= asset.max_deposit_amount

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-029.text: Total borrow must not exceed per-asset max_borrow_amount ceiling.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-030.text: Emode group total borrow must not exceed emode_max_borrow limit.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-030.assertion: forall borrow(amt, emode): emode_total_borrow + amt <= emode_max_borrow

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-031.text: Emode group borrow amount must be updated on both borrow and repay operations.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-032.text: Overpayment in repay must be returned as refund, not absorbed by protocol.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-032.assertion: forall repay(obl, coin): if coin.value() > debt.ceil(): refund = coin.value() - debt.ceil()

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-033.text: Debt interest accrual must use ratio of new_index/old_index, not absolute difference.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-034.text: Simple interest factor must use exact elapsed time, not rounded to nearest block/epoch.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-034.assertion: simple_interest_factor = interest_rate * (now - last_updated), where now = clock_ms / 1000

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-035.text: Zero-debt entries must be removed from obligation after full repay to prevent ghost positions.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-035.assertion: forall repay(obl, type): if debt(type) == 0: debts.remove(type)

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-036.text: Reward claim must only be executable by obligation owner via obligation_owner_cap.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-036.assertion: forall claim_reward(obl): caller owns ObligationOwnerCap where cap.id matches obligation

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-037.text: Reward index must be updated before claiming to prevent stale reward calculation.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-037.assertion: forall claim_reward: reward_manager.update_index(shares, clock) before claim(obligation_id)

PROP-01b-partial2-pre-006.text: ADL borrow deleverage must require total debt to breach target_amount before activation.

PROP-01b-partial2-pre-007.text: ADL collateral deleverage must require total deposit to breach target_amount before activation.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-038.text: Version check must be enforced on all entry point functions to prevent stale contract calls.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-038.assertion: forall entry_point: ensure_version_matches() called before any state mutation

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-039.text: Circuit breaker must prevent all lending operations when triggered for a market.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-039.assertion: forall op when circuit_break(market): op aborts with market_under_circuit_break

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-040.text: Rate limiter deposit reduce_outflow on deposit must correctly offset prior add_outflow on withdraw.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-040.assertion: deposit: emode.deposit_limiter.reduce_outflow(now, amount) reduces current segment value

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-041.text: Deposit and borrow rate limiters must use separate outflow tracking to prevent cross-limit bypass.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-042.text: Reserve repay overpayment (repay > total debt) excess must go to cash_reserve, not vanish.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-042.assertion: if repay_amount > debt: cash_reserve += (repay_amount - debt.ceil()); debt = 0

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-043.text: Obligation interest refresh must cover ALL debt types and collateral types before safety check.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-043.assertion: refresh_obligation_assets_interest iterates all debts and all collaterals, not just target type

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-044.text: Each obligation must belong to exactly one market; cross-market obligation sharing must be impossible.
PROP-01b-partial2-inv-044.assertion: forall obl: obl.market_id() is set once at creation and never changes

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-045.text: Emode group must exist in registry before obligation creation to prevent phantom group references.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-046.text: Liquidation with zero repay amount must be rejected to prevent zero-amount griefing.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-047.text: Collateral asset must have can_be_collateral flag set to true for liquidation seize.

PROP-01b-partial2-inv-048.text: ADL liquidation_revenue_factor must be zero to not extract protocol revenue during auto-deleverage.

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-001.text: Exchange rate must equal (cash + totalBorrows - reserves) / cTokenSupply when supply > 0.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-001.assertion: forall market m: m.totalSupply > 0 => exchangeRate(m) == (getCash(m) + m.totalBorrows - m.totalReserves) / m.totalSupply

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-002.text: Exchange rate must be monotonically non-decreasing over time (absent bad debt).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-002.assertion: forall market m, t1 < t2: exchangeRate(m, t2) >= exchangeRate(m, t1) when no bad_debt(m)

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-003.text: First depositor cannot manipulate exchange rate to steal subsequent depositors' funds.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-003.assertion: forall market m: m.totalSupply == 0 => mint(m, amt) gives mintTokens >= min_threshold AND no inflation attack

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-004.text: Underlying token transfer must succeed before minting cTokens (CEI pattern).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-004.assertion: forall mint(user, amt): doTransferIn(user, amt).success == true BEFORE totalSupply += mintTokens

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-005.text: totalSupply must increase by exactly mintAmount/exchangeRate on mint.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-005.assertion: forall mint(user, amt): totalSupply_post == totalSupply_pre + floor(amt / exchangeRate)

PROP-01b-partial3-pre-001.text: Redeem must not cause borrower shortfall (collateral check before withdrawal).
PROP-01b-partial3-pre-001.assertion: forall redeem(user, tokens): getAccountLiquidity(user).shortfall == 0 AFTER redeem

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-006.text: Market must have sufficient cash for withdrawal (getCash >= redeemAmount).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-006.assertion: forall redeem(user, amt): getCash(market) >= redeemAmount => transfer succeeds

PROP-01b-partial3-pre-002.text: Borrow must not exceed borrowing capacity (collateral value > total borrow value).
PROP-01b-partial3-pre-002.assertion: forall borrow(user, amt): sum(collateral_i * exchangeRate_i * price_i * CF_i) > sum(borrow_j * price_j) + amt * price

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-007.text: totalBorrows must increase by exactly the borrowed amount after borrow.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-007.assertion: forall borrow(user, amt): totalBorrows_post == totalBorrows_pre + amt

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-008.text: Borrower checkpoint index must equal market borrow index at time of borrow.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-008.assertion: forall borrow(user, amt): accountBorrows[user].interestIndex == borrowIndex after borrow

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-009.text: borrowBalanceCurrent must include all accrued interest: principal * currentIndex / storedIndex.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-009.assertion: forall account a: borrowBalance(a) == a.principal * borrowIndex / a.interestIndex

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-010.text: repayAmount must not exceed current borrow balance (no overpayment).

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-011.text: totalBorrows must decrease by exactly repayAmount after repay.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-011.assertion: forall repay(user, amt): totalBorrows_post == totalBorrows_pre - actualRepayAmount

PROP-01b-partial3-pre-003.text: Liquidation requires borrower shortfall > 0 (borrower must be underwater).

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-012.text: Liquidation closeAmount must not exceed borrowBalance * closeFactor.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-012.assertion: forall liquidate(liq, borrower, amt): actualClose <= borrowBalance(borrower) * closeFactor

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-013.assertion: forall liquidate(liq, borrower, amt): liq != borrower

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-014.text: Seize must not change totalSupply of collateral cToken (transfer, not mint/burn).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-014.assertion: forall seize(liq, borrower, tokens): collateral.totalSupply_post == collateral.totalSupply_pre

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-015.text: seizeTokens calculation must correctly include liquidation incentive and oracle prices.

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-016.text: borrowIndex must be monotonically increasing (never decrease).
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-016.assertion: forall market m, t1 < t2: borrowIndex(m, t2) >= borrowIndex(m, t1)

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-017.text: accrueInterest must be idempotent within the same block.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-017.assertion: forall market m: accrueInterest(m) called twice in same block => second call is no-op
